toegepas.blok: Hoe jy die drie uitmekaar ken
toegepas.voor: Water giet maklik, en dit bly
toegepas.na: Jy kan water maklik giet, en dit bly
toegepas.rede_vinder: Intransitive 'water giet maklik' copies English 'water pours easily'; in Afrikaans intransitive 'giet' suggests pouring rain, and the block's own question is 'of jy dit kan giet'.
toegepas.fout: Intransitive 'water giet maklik' copies English 'water pours easily'; intransitive giet suggests rain pouring down.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal is natural Afrikaans, matches the block's own question 'of jy dit kan giet', and keeps the meaning, the comma and the reference of dit.

laat_vaar.blok: Alles om jou is van materiaal gemaak
laat_vaar.voor: Die water binne die bottel is ook 'n materiaal
laat_vaar.na: Die water binne die bottel is ook materiaal
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The next sentence says 'is ook materiaal' for air; using the same mass-noun form for both keeps the parallel clean.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Count-noun 'n materiaal is normal Afrikaans and is the form the lesson's own shared definition of eienskap uses, so the change is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Alles om jou is van materiaal gemaak
laat_vaar.voor: Al die materiaal om jou is een van drie soorte
laat_vaar.na: Al die materiaal om jou is van drie soorte
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Al die materiaal is een van drie soorte' literally says all material together is one kind; 'is van drie soorte' is the natural idiom for 'comes in three kinds'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original reads distributively (each material is one of three kinds), and 'is van drie soorte' drops the 'one of', which is the sorting claim, so the meaning moves.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n Ent' denotes a distance or stretch of way and sounds odd with 'platdruk'; 'n bietjie' is the natural amount word.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n Ent for an amount of movement is idiomatic (as in 'n deur 'n entjie oopmaak), and 'n bietjie weakens the noticeable flattening the sentence describes.

na_skrywer.voor: Materiaal sonder eie vorm wat versprei en 'n hele houer vul.
na_skrywer.na: Materiaal sonder 'n eie vorm, wat versprei en 'n hele houer vul.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Without the comma the relative clause can attach to 'vorm' (a shape that spreads); the comma and article tie it to 'Materiaal'.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative clause 'wat versprei' sits directly after 'vorm' and could be read as attaching to it rather than to 'Materiaal'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition shared across lessons, and the proposed comma would also make a defining clause non-defining, so the writer should decide on a fix for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: By 'n gasstoof brand die gas met 'n vlam onder die pot, en daardie gas is, net soos lug, 'n gas.
vlae.rede: 'Daardie gas is ... 'n gas' is circular; the intended point (stove gas is also a gas like air, though not air) cannot be reworded without guessing content, so it goes to the writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'n Bietjie water is the natural, simpler Grade 4 phrasing for the same amount.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Hoeveelheid' links to 'dieselfde hoeveelheid water' three sentences later, which is the point of the block, so the swap disturbs a neighbour.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: diep onder die water in 'n emmer in
laat_vaar_vorige.na: diep onder die water in 'n emmer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The double in is clumsy; the closing in is unnecessary.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The in...in circumposition is grammatical Afrikaans for motion into the water, and dropping a particle from an activity step is not worth the risk.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Repeating the article reads more naturally for two separate objects.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n Glas of bak is natural Afrikaans with a shared article, and the glossary entry should not be touched for a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: stoot terug teen jou twee hande
laat_vaar_vorige.na: stoot teen jou twee hande terug
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The separable verb 'terugstoot' reads more naturally with its particle at the end of the clause.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'stoot terug teen jou hande' is natural Afrikaans; moving the particle is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die water styg by die mond in
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die water stroom by die mond in
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'styg ... in' is an unnatural verb combination; 'stroom by die mond in' is idiomatic and keeps the meaning of water entering the bottle.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'styg' carries the upward movement of the water into the upturned bottle, which 'stroom' loses, and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy die drie uitmekaar ken
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Vra laastens of sy stil boonste kant plat lê
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Vra laastens of die materiaal se stil boonste kant plat lê
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sy' here has no clear antecedent in the sentence and can be misread as 'she'; naming the material makes the reference clear and leaves 'stil boonste kant' intact.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' is the ordinary possessive of 'dit' (the material in the previous questions) and cannot be read as 'she' here; the proposal only lengthens the sentence.
